title: .NET Full-Stack Software Engineer (IRC303351)
description:
Job Description
Front-End Development
Strong commercial experience with React
Proficiency in TypeScript
Experience building applications using Next.js
Experience developing and documenting reusable UI components with Storybook
Ability to interpret and implement designs from Figma
Experience writing unit and component tests using Jest
Strong knowledge of modern HTML and CSS, including CSS custom properties, responsive design, Flexbox and CSS Grid
Understanding of accessibility, browser compatibility and front-end performance best practices
Back-End Development
Strong commercial experience with ASP.NET Core and C#
Experience designing and developing secure, maintainable REST APIs
Experience with Azure Functions and serverless application development
Knowledge of Azure API Management
Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server, including database design and query optimisation
Experience working with Azure Cosmos DB
Understanding of authentication, authorisation and API security, ideally Duende Identity Server
Job Responsibilities
Design, implement and unit test core application components running on Azure
Drive and participate in the functional design
Contribute to the review and analysis of business requirements and development of code reviews and technical designs/specifications
Participate in SCRUM
Department/Project Description
The client is a holding company that administers association football clubs including Manchester City F.C. As for the product, it is mancity.com website and all innfrastructure around. We are using Scrum. Technologies/Tools: - Back-end: C#, .Net; ASP.NET; ASP.NET Web API; Umbraco; MS SQL. - Front-end: HTML/CSS, Angular, WebPack. - Other: Jira, Git, Docker, MS Azure.
